rows.en: (Today I came to Silver Moon with Shirakawa!)
rows.notes: x2, male, frd_myk_103 (both visits use it). Silver Moon is provisional.

rows.en:
This tea is delicious,
isn't it, \p-kun?

Oh, so the tea here has Shirakawa's
seal of approval, huh?
Geez... Please don't tease me!

Yeah, I'm glad I got to talk with you about
all sorts of things, Shirakawa.
rows.notes: Male; follows Miyuki's 'Thanks for the meal'.

rows.en:
As long as it's something I know,
feel free to ask me anything.
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; the player answers 'I'll do that.'

rows.en:
Oh, I've got plans after this,
so I'll head home first.
(Today I came to Silver Moon with Miyuki.)

This tea is delicious,
isn't it, \p-san?

Ooh, so the tea here has Miyuki's
seal of approval~

Yeah, talking with you about all sorts
of things was fun, Miyuki!
I'll do that.
rows.notes: Female; same as the male c10290.

rows.en: The coffee's good too.

It's good, but the menu's way too long.
I can't make heads or tails of it...
Hehe, maybe you're right!

Yeah, I'm glad I got to talk with you about
all sorts of things again today, Shirakawa.
I had fun too.

Hearing you say that makes me glad
I invited you.

Oh, I've got a little something to do
after this, so I'll head home first.
(Today I came to Silver Moon with Miyuki again.)

The coffee's good too.
And they have so many toppings to choose from.

I like mine with loads of whipped cream.
And I never forget the caramel sauce.

Hehe.
At that rate, you won't be able to tell it's coffee.
Yeah, that was delicious~!
(Today I came to Central Park with Shirakawa!)
Shall we walk for a bit today?
The breeze felt nice, didn't it?
Yeah, I feel totally refreshed.
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders (rifuresshu, not the sukkiri gag).

rows.en:
Me too...
Maybe next time we could go cycling.
Yeah, the park seems pretty big, after all.

Well then, how about we go get some tea?
I'm getting a little thirsty.
(Today I came to Central Park with Miyuki.)

Well then, how about we go get some tea?
I'm getting a little thirsty!

(Today I'm hanging out at Central Park
with Shirakawa again!)
Sorry to keep you waiting, Shirakawa!
Shall we ride bikes today?

All right, let's race and see who can
do a lap faster!
I won't lose!
That was so much fun!

You're really good at sports and stuff,
huh, Shirakawa.
Th-that's not true... is it?

No way, you looked so full of life when
you were riding that bike, Shirakawa.
I can't really tell myself, but...

Well then, let's grab some tea somewhere
before we head home.
(Today I came to Central Park with Miyuki again.)
Sorry to keep you waiting, Miyuki!

All right, let's race and see who can
do a lap faster!

You're really good at sports and stuff,
huh, Miyuki...

No way, you looked so full of life when
you were riding that bike, Miyuki.

(Today I'm supposed to go to Deep Akihabara
with Shirakawa, but...)
rows.notes: Male, frd_myk_105. Deep Akihabara is provisional.

rows.en:
\p-kun,
I'm sorry I'm late...

Nah, don't worry about it.
Actually, I was running a little late too.
O-oh, were you?
Now I feel like I apologized for nothing!

Sorry, sorry...
Well then, shall we go shopping?
This town really does have all kinds of things.

This town's selling point is that it has everything.
You don't come here much, do you, Shirakawa?

No, I get most of my things
in the Shibuya Area.
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; 'hai' agrees with the negative question, so 'No' in English.

rows.en:
I see. So, did you learn a thing or two
about the real world?
I had a really good time.

(Today I'm supposed to go to Deep Akihabara
with Miyuki, but...)

\p-san,
I'm sorry I'm late...

Nah, don't worry about it.
Actually, I was running a little late too...

Sorry, sorry...
Well then, let's go shopping!

This town's selling point is that it has everything~
You don't come here much, do you, Miyuki?

(Today I came to Deep Akihabara with Shirakawa
again.)

\p-kun,
sorry to keep you waiting.
rows.notes: Miyuki to the male player; as c09341 (-san version).

rows.en: Oh, you're right on time today.
O-oh, am I?
I meant to get here early, though...

Good thing neither of us got left waiting.
Well then, let's go shopping.

They even sell tea leaves here.
And rare ones, too...

No idea where they got 'em from, though...
I think the taste should be fine.
I'll brew some as soon as I get home.
Let me know how it tastes.
Yes, next time.

(Today I came to Deep Akihabara with Miyuki
again.)
Oh, you're right on time today!

Good thing neither of us got left waiting.
Well then, shall we go shopping?

No idea where they got 'em from, though...
I think the taste should be fine~

c11139, c11150, c11155, c11166: use Deep Akihabara (provisional in locations.json).
